commentary.text: 90+13' 1 - 4 El Bilal Toure (Atalanta) heads the ball inside the left post after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
90+10' 1 - 3 Goal! The rebound fell to Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) and he fired home from close range. The score is 1:3.
90+10' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) gets inside the box and tries to beat Josep Martinez with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
90+9' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) took the corner.
90+8' Genoa failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+8' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
90+7' Atalanta can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+7' The game is interrupted. Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.

90+7' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The referee signals a corner kick to Atalanta.
90+7' It will be a corner kick for Atalanta.
90+5' Gian Piero Gasperini prepares a substitution. Matteo Ruggeri is replaced by Hans Hateboer (Atalanta).
90+3' Aaron Martin (Genoa) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Andrea Colombo ignores the protests.
90+2' The manager makes a subsitution with Vitinha (Genoa) coming on for Alessandro Vogliacco.
90+2' Andrea Colombo shows the yellow card to Marten de Roon (Atalanta) for a heavy challenge.
90+1' The ball is out of play. Atalanta win a corner kick.
90+1' Atalanta will take a corner kick.
90+1' El Bilal Toure (Atalanta) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. Atalanta force a corner. They send men into the box.
90' The fourth official shows 10 min. of added time.
88' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a change. Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) replaces Giorgio Scalvini.
88' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) attempts to turn the rebound in from close range. Nevertheless, the goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save and stops the ball from hitting the net. Great goalkeeping.
86' Andrea Colombo couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) and blew his whistle.
83' We are about to witness a substitution. Junior Messias (Genoa) is replacing Stefano Sabelli.
83' The goal by Atalanta is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
78' The Atalanta players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
77' Goal-line technology proves its worth as ref immediately confirms the ball crossed the line!
76' Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 1:3.
76' Josep Martinez makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded low towards the middle of the goal by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) after a cross from the side.
74' A free kick from around the half-way line will be taken by Genoa.
73' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
71' El Bilal Toure (Atalanta) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
69' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
65' Genoa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
63' Here's the change. Kevin Strootman leaves the pitch and Aaron Martin (Genoa) comes on as a substitute.
63' Alberto Gilardino has decided to substitute Milan Badelj and he is replaced by Caleb Ekuban (Genoa).
62' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.

60' Josep Martinez pulls off a great save to deny Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
59' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
57' El Bilal Toure (Atalanta) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Charles De Ketelaere.
57' Here is a change. Gianluca Scamacca is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta).
57' Substitution. Emil Holm makes way for Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta).

55' 1 - 2 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the right side of the net.
55' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
54' Today's referee Andrea Colombo rightly decides to book Mattia Bani (Genoa) for his harsh tackle.
53' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
51' 1 - 1 Goal! Milan Badelj plays a short, square pass into the path of Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa), who bends a shot straight into the left side of the goal to make it 1:1. Fabulous goal!
50' Wasted opportunity. Morten Frendrup (Genoa) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post.
49' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Genoa.
49' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the left side of the goal, but Marco Carnesecchi pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
47' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes well past the left post.
47' Kevin Strootman (Genoa) tries to find Mateo Retegui, but he puts too much power on the pass.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.
45+2' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but Josep Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.
45' That's all for today as the game is over.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
44' Emil Holm (Atalanta) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
42' Kevin Strootman (Genoa) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
42' A snap shot by Mateo Retegui (Genoa) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Marco Carnesecchi produces a good save to thwart him.
40' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
37' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
37' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
36' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
35' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
34' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) tries his luck from the edge of the box, but it's one to forget and goes well wide of the left post.
33' Genoa will look to take advantage of a free kick in a promising position in the middle of the field.
32' Andrea Colombo shows a yellow card to Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) for a tough tackle.
32' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
32' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) sends the corner into the box, but Marco Carnesecchi intercepts it and averts the threat.
32' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
31' The ball goes out of play and Genoa have been awarded a corner kick.
31' A cross into the box from Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) is cleared.
30' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Andrea Colombo signals.
29' Half-chance! Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) plays a pass into the box, but Josep Martinez reacts well to snuff out the attack.
28' Milan Badelj (Genoa) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
27' Milan Badelj (Genoa) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
24' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is booked for saying more than Andrea Colombo was willing to tolerate.
24' The main referee, Andrea Colombo, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Kevin Strootman (Genoa) is given a yellow card for dissent.

22' 0 - 1 Mario Pasalic passes to Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes inside the right post. Fabulous goal! The score is 0:1.
21' Emil Holm (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
21' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
20' Rough tackle by Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Atalanta earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
19' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) makes a strong challenge and Andrea Colombo blows for a foul.
16' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
14' A pass by Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
12' The cross into the penalty area from Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
12' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Genoa.
9' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) commits a rough challenge and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for an infringement.
6' Genoa move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession.
4' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
3' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

The players are on the pitch and Genoa will have the kick-off.
Andrea Colombo is the one to supervise the game today.
